description: This file defines the OfbizUrlBuilder class, which provides methods for constructing full or partial URLs within the OFBiz web application framework. It handles building URLs with proper scheme, host, servlet path, and resource, considering security settings, configuration, and request parameters.

classes.name: OfbizUrlBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing URLs within the OFBiz framework, considering security, configuration, and request context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance based on an HttpServletRequest, initializing configuration, website properties, and servlet path.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance for scheduled jobs or non-request contexts, based on WebappInfo and Delegator, initializing configuration and website properties.

methods.name: buildFullUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL including scheme, host, servlet path, and resource, with options for SSL and path shortening.

methods.name: buildHostPart
methods.description: Builds the scheme and host part of the URL, considering security settings and request map configuration.

methods.name: buildPathPart
methods.description: Builds the servlet path and resource portion of the URL, with optional path shortening.
